Surge]]'s {{p|Electabuzz}} and {{Adv|Bill}}'s {{p|Vulpix}}. Vulpix and Electabuzz shove Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan, who land on their feet on the {{p|Onix}} bridge. Hitmonchan unleashes a barrage of {{m|Comet Punch}}es, and Hitmonlee attacks with a powerful {{m|Rolling Kick}}. {{Adv|Yellow}} and {{adv|Blaine}}, seeing how bad the situation is for Bill and Lt. Surge, have [[Pika]] and {{p|Rapidash}} use {{m|Thunder Shock}} and {{m|Fire Spin}}, respectively. However, not even a dent appears on the wall. Bruno tells them to leave, but Yellow and Blaine keep trying to break the wall. For punishment, an Onix wraps around them. On the other side of the wall, Lt. Surge and Bill come up with a battle strategy to face Bruno's {{p|Machamp}}. When Machamp comes to Bill and Lt. Surge, they run away. Next to Machamp, two hidden {{i|Poké Ball}}s open, and Bill's {{p|Exeggcute}} and Lt. Surge's {{p|Electrode}} come out. Exeggcute uses {{m|Egg Bomb}} and {{m|Barrage}} to shoot out floating groups of eggs. Then, Electrode uses {{m|Self-Destruct}} to make the groups of eggs explode, which causes the Onix to thrash in pain, sending Bruno, Machamp, Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, Bill, Exeggcute, Vulpix, Lt. Surge, and Electrode down. Four {{p|Magneton}} appear and stop Lt. Surge, Bill, and their [[Pokémon]] from falling by creating a magnetic pyramid around them (other than Lt. Surge, who is climbing up on a Magneton). Bill looks down at the acid below and knows that if Bruno did fall in, he couldn't have survived. ==Major events== * [[Lt. Surge]] and {{adv|Bill}} battle against [[Bruno]]. * {{Adv|Yellow}} and {{adv|Blaine}} try to help [[Lt. Surge]] and {{adv|Bill}}, but are blocked from helping. * [[Lt. Surge]] and {{adv|Bill}} defeat [[Bruno]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Bill}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Lt.
